Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll typically find in a traditional lasagna recipe: | Category | Typical Ingredients | |----------|---------------------| | **Lasagna Noodles** | • 9–12 sheets (regular or no‑boil) | | **Meat Sauce** | • 1 lb ground beef
• 1 lb Italian sausage (optional)
• 1 small onion, finely chopped
• 2–3 cloves garlic, minced
• 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes or whole‑tomato sauce
• 1 can (15 oz) tomato paste
• 1 cup beef or chicken broth (or water)
• 1 tsp dried oregano
• 1 tsp dried basil
• ½ tsp dried thyme
• Salt & pepper to taste | | **Ricotta Layer** | • 15 oz ricotta cheese
• 1 egg (helps bind)
• ¼ cup grated Parmesan
• Pinch of nutmeg (optional)
• Salt & pepper | | **Mozzarella Layer** | • 2 cups shredded mozzarella (part‑mozzarella or part‑cheddar mix works too) | | **Parmesan Layer** | • ¾ cup grated Parmesan (for topping) | | **Optional Extras** | • 1 cup fresh spinach or kale (blanched)
• ½ cup sliced mushrooms
• ½ cup diced bell peppers
• 1 tbsp olive oil (for sautéing veggies) | ### Quick Prep Steps 1. **Cook noodles** according to package instructions (or use no‑boil). Drain and set aside. 2. **Make meat sauce**: Sauté onions & garlic → add ground meats → brown → stir in tomatoes, broth, herbs → simmer 20–30 min. 3. **Prepare ricotta mixture**: Beat ricotta, egg, Parmesan, nutmeg, salt, pepper. 4. **Layer**: Start with a thin sauce layer → noodles → ricotta mixture → mozzarella → repeat until all layers used. Finish with mozzarella + Parmesan on top. 5. **Bake** at 375°F (190°C) for 35–45 min, covered with foil first 25 min, then uncovered to brown. Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
